moisture.source: Typical Grove moisture sensor ranges (dry soil about 0-300, humid 300-700). Used only when a node has no calibration; the dashboard labels it.

defaults.auto_tilt_baseline_note: If a live node has no saved tilt baseline, the backend uses the first 10 still seconds after it connects as a session baseline (labelled on screen). Run calibrate --step baseline for a proper one.

moisture.notes: Capture with: python -m backend.sensors calibrate --port <port> --step dry (then --step wet)

tilt.notes: Install the stake, then --step baseline. Lean it slightly downslope, --step downslope, then stand it back up.

moisture.notes: Simulated stake used in replays and as a filler node.
